title: Obtaining cells from colon of dog with leishmaniasis for flow cytometric analysis
protocol: Remove the colon punch biopsies to isolate lamina propria cells.
Wash the entire length of colon thoroughly with incomplete medium (RPMI) in a Petri dish.
Transfer the fragments to another Petri dish containing 10mL of complete medium, incubated in ice.
Remove the fat from small fragments of colonic tissue using forceps and surgical scissors.
Place the samples in a Petri dish and shake with slow agitation (100rpm) for 10 min.
Remove the supernatant with a Pasteur pipette and discard.
Repeat the shaking and supernatant removal process six times.
Transfer the fragments of tissue to a small culture bottle containing 10mL incubation solution (DTT).
Incubate in a shaker at 37°C for 30 min (120rpm).
Discard the incubation solution and repeat the process for another 30 min.
Add 10mL wash solution (HBSS/HEPES) to the tissue fragments.
Shake for 10 min (120rpm) at 37°C.
Repeat the washing process with HBSS/HEPES for a further 10 min.
After washing, add 10mL collagenase solution to the bottle containing tissue fragments.
Gently shake in the shaker for 45 min at 37°C.
Remove the collagenase solution supernatant after 45 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a Falcon® 15mL tube.
Centrifuge the supernatant at 1400rpm for 10min at 4°C.
Resuspend in 0.5µL complete medium and store on ice.
Repeat these steps four times.
Place the cells in a single Falcon® 15mL tube.
Add 9mL of distilled water to lyse erythrocytes.
Add 1mL of PBS ten seconds later to neutralize lysis.
Centrifuge at 1400rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5µL complete medium.
Analyze the number of cells in a 10µL sample using a Neubauer camera.
Calibrate the solution to 1x10^7 cells/mL.
Block cells with leishmaniasis negative dog serum and keep on ice for at least 20 minutes.
Dilute antibodies for superficial markers with ADS.
Dilute intracellular markers in permeabilization buffer.
Plate cell suspensions (20µL) on 96-well U-bottom plates (Limbro Biomedicals® 175, Aurora, OH, USA) at a concentration of 1x10^7 cells/mL.
Add antibodies to cell surface.
Refrigerate the plate for 15 min.
Add 150 µL of cold PBS to each well.
Centrifuge at 1300 rpm at 4°C for 10 min.
Remove the supernatant from the wells.
Add 200 µL of 2% formaldehyde to fix the cells.
Transfer the contents of the wells to FACS tubes.
Store in the refrigerator in the dark.
Remove the supernatant for intracellular marking.
Add 150 µL of PBS-W and centrifuge at 1300 rpm at 4°C for 10 min.
Remove the supernatant again.
Add 150 µL of permeabilization buffer to the samples.
Slowly mix the samples manually and keep them for 10 min at ambient temperature.
Centrifuge the plate for an additional 10 min at 1300 rpm at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Add intracellular antibodies including isotypes and incubate for 40 min at room temperature.
Add 150 µL of permeabilization buffer, centrifuge, and remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 150 µL PBS-W.
Centrifuge and remove the supernatant.
Add 200 µL of 2% formaldehyde to the wells.
Transfer the content of the wells to FACS tubes.
Store in the refrigerator in the dark.
Analyze cells on an analytical flow cytometer equipped with a 488nm laser.
Acquire data from 50,000 events.
Distinguish whole cells from fragments by gating based on forward and side scatter signals.
Process numerical data using FlowJo software version 7.2.5.
Assess the lamina propria population cells of the colon.
Express phenotypic aspects of lamina propria cells as a percentage of cells expressing a given marker.
Use cell and isotype control cutoff with bimodal distribution for percentages.
Use geometric mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) for semi-quantitative expression of markers with unimodal distribution.
Employ three-color flow cytometry panels optimized for dogs to characterize mononuclear cells phenotypically in colon biopsies.
Focus on the composition of sub-populations.
Survey CD4+, CD4+, FOXP3+, CD8+, CD11b+, CD11c+, TLR9+, TLR2+, CD14+ and mannose+ cells.
